sloka: तेन पूरयता वेगान्मध्ये भग्नं द्विधा धनु: ।तस्य शब्दो ऽभवद्भीम: पतितस्याशनेरिव ॥ २.११८.४९॥
transliteration: tena pūrayatā vegānmadhye bhagnaṁ dvidhā dhanu: ।tasya śabdo 'bhavadbhīma: patitasyāśaneriva ॥ 2.118.49॥

translations.english: When Rama was stringing the bow with force, it was broken into two in the middle and fell down with a dreadful sound like that of thunder.
